title: WrestleMania VII
summary: This document provides a comprehensive overview of WrestleMania VII, the seventh annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), held on March 24, 1991, at the Los Angeles Memorial Sports Arena in Los Angeles, California. The document begins with background information on the event, including its original scheduled venue (the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum), the reasons behind the venue change (security concerns stemming from Sgt. Slaughter's Iraqi sympathizer gimmick during the Gulf War, combined with poor ticket sales), the event's American patriotic theme ("Superstars and Stripes Forever"), celebrity guests such as Willie Nelson, Regis Philbin, and Alex Trebek, and details on the commentary team. The storylines section covers the two main feuds: Hulk Hogan's challenge to WWF Champion Sgt. Slaughter, who portrayed an Iraqi sympathizer aligned with Saddam Hussein, and Ultimate Warrior's rivalry with Randy Savage, which led to a retirement match after Savage's interference cost Warrior his title at the Royal Rumble. The event section provides detailed match-by-match accounts of all fourteen matches, highlighting key moments such as The Undertaker's WrestleMania debut and the beginning of his undefeated streak, the Nasty Boys defeating the Hart Foundation for the tag team titles, Warrior defeating Savage in the retirement match leading to his reunion with Miss Elizabeth, and Hulk Hogan defeating Sgt. Slaughter in the main event to win his record third WWF Championship. The document concludes with reception details (attendance figures and critic reviews) and an aftermath section describing subsequent storylines, including Hogan's continued feud with Slaughter, Savage's transition to commentary and on-air wedding to Miss Elizabeth, the dissolution of the Hart Foundation and Bret Hart's rise as a singles star, and André the Giant's final WrestleMania appearance.
